title: One purchase, two settled charges
text: I paid Rs 2400 at a supermarket once, but my bank statement shows two charges. Both entries are marked completed and the merchant receipt shows only one payment. I contacted support three times and each agent told me to wait. I am frustrated because nobody has given me a case update.

title: Recipient still waiting for money
text: I transferred Rs 12000 to my landlord four days ago. The money has left my account but the recipient says nothing has arrived. The app says the transfer is complete. I contacted support twice and was sent to different agents.

title: A card payment I did not make
text: There is a card payment for Rs 8600 to a merchant I do not recognize. I did not authorize this transaction and my card is still with me. I am worried about more charges.

title: Merchant refund missing from balance
text: The store says my refund was issued twelve days ago, but the refund is not showing in my bank account. I have a refund receipt from the merchant. The money still has not arrived.

title: Another duplicate grocery payment
text: My grocery card transaction has been charged twice. I made only one purchase and both payments show as completed on the statement. Can someone check the duplicate charge?

title: Bank transfer stuck as pending
text: My bank transfer has been pending since yesterday morning. The amount is unavailable in my account and the app gives no expected completion time. Why is the transfer still pending?

title: ATM kept my bank card
text: An ATM swallowed my card when I tried to withdraw cash this morning. The machine did not return my card and I do not know if it is blocked. I need help protecting it.

title: Lost card needs immediate protection
text: I lost my bank card on the bus today. I cannot find it and I want to freeze the card before someone makes a payment. Please help me get a replacement.

title: Failed transfer with debit remaining
text: My transfer failed in the app, but Rs 5000 was debited from my balance. The recipient did not receive any money. I need to know where the failed transfer amount went.

title: Card keeps declining at checkout
text: My card payment was declined at two stores today although I have enough money in my account. The payment will not go through. What is causing these declined card payments?

title: Salary transfer has not appeared
text: My employer sent a bank transfer to my account two days ago. They have a transfer confirmation, but my balance has not updated and the incoming transfer is missing.

title: Online purchase charged twice
text: I bought a book online with my card, and the same transaction was charged twice. My statement has two charges for the same order. The seller confirmed only one order exists.

title: Card no longer works
text: My bank card is not working anywhere. It fails with the chip and for online payments. The card has not expired and I need to understand why it stopped working.

title: Hotel payment still pending
text: A hotel card payment is still marked pending on my account after checkout. The hotel says the final bill was paid. Why is the earlier card payment still pending?

title: Transfer sent but not received
text: I sent a transfer to my sister last week. The transfer has left my bank account but she has not received it. The beneficiary details are correct and we need a trace.

title: Unrecognized overnight payment
text: I woke up to a card charge that I do not recognize. I was at home and did not make this payment. I want to block the card and dispute the transaction.

title: Duplicate restaurant bill
text: The restaurant payment is showing twice on my bank statement. I paid the bill once, but there are two completed card charges for the same amount and merchant.

title: Refund has not reached account
text: My cancelled order was refunded by the seller, but I still cannot see the refund in my account. The merchant provided a refund reference and I have been waiting for the money.

title: Transfer processing without update
text: A transfer I submitted is still pending. It has not completed after two business days and I have no clear update about the bank transfer status.

title: Incoming payment not in balance
text: A friend made a bank transfer into my account yesterday. They sent proof of the payment but my balance is unchanged. I cannot find the incoming transfer in my transaction history.

title: ATM retained the card after timeout
text: The cash machine retained my card after the screen timed out. I could not get the card back from the ATM. I need the bank to help me secure the card.

title: Failed bank transfer needs reversal
text: The bank transfer I tried to send was marked failed. Money was taken from my account and has not been returned. Please check the failed transfer and its reversal.

title: Merchant payment declined again
text: My card was declined while paying for groceries. There are enough funds and I have not reached my spending limit. I tried another terminal but the card payment was declined again.

title: Repeated charges for one subscription
text: My monthly subscription payment has been charged twice this month. There should be one card transaction, but my account shows two completed charges for the same merchant and amount.
